description: Turning either flag off: subscriptions of that profile end with feature_disabled from the first read or attempt; the encrypted secrets are deleted; notifications and http-wake subscriptions are untouched.

steps.does: sets ENVOI_MCP_EVENTS_V1 and ENVOI_GROK_TRIGGER_V1 off and restarts
every stored events subscription and Grok target of that profile reads ended / feature_disabled; no attempt is made; the stored secret is deleted on the first read after the flag-off start
events/subscribe is an unknown method; its safety poll through envoi_claim_work continues
work, leases, the a4 stream and Ed25519 http-wake subscriptions are unchanged
